SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 5, 2024 - 05:00 P.M.
SKYLINE ROOM B - CERRITOS LIBRARY
18025 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting in person in Skyline Room B at the Cerritos Library.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office of the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 12:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD THURSDAY,
SEPTEMBER 5, 2024, 5:00 P.M., IN THE SKYLINE ROOM B AT THE CERRITOS LIBRARY,
18025 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m.

 2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

 3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Bruce W. Barrows (arrived at 5:05 p.m.)
  Councilmember Lynda P. Johnson
  Councilmember Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem Chuong Vo
  Mayor Naresh Solanki

 4.  Public Comments and Suggestions (Special Meeting Agenda Item 5)
  (Notation: Special meeting public comments were limited to Item 5 as listed on the special
  meeting agenda).

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Seeing none, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period closed.

 5.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss Items 5A, 5B, and 5C as listed on the Closed Session agenda.

  5A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  5B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  5C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer

  The City Council recessed into Closed Session.

  The City Council reconvened into Open Session.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT:

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer, provided the following Closed Session report:

  The City Council convened into Closed Session to discuss Item 5C as listed on the agenda.
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer announced that she had notified the City Council that she
  would be retiring from the City of Cerritos effective Friday, September 13, 2024. Items 5A
  and 5B were not discussed. There was no reportable action taken on any item and there
  was nothing further to report.

  The meeting adjourned at 6:30 p.m.
